title: santalum salicifolium
intro: Santalum salicifolium, commonly known as the "Weeping Sandalwood", is a species of evergreen tree native to Australia. The health benefits of Santalum salicifolium include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Santalum salicifolium include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
